verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an SaaS observability platform that ships SDKs and a CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a way to disable vendor telemetry or usage tracking in the SDKs, CLI or platform. The self-hosting option keeps customer AI data in your own cloud, but Braintrust still runs the managed UI and platform, and that option is about data residency, not opting out of the vendor's own usage tracking.
